## 1. Security & Identity Guidelines

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Zero Passwords in Plaintext**: Never enter passwords into this onboarding document. Users will receive secure, one-time activation tokens to set their own secure credentials upon account provisioning.
> - **Canonical Role Model**: Application roles are strictly: `MASTER`, `OWNER`, `CAFE_ADMIN`, `STAFF`. Business titles (e.g. *Cashier*, *General Manager*, *Lead Barista*) are designations and map to these four roles.
> - **Unique Corporate Accounts**: Every pilot user must have an individual real email address (no shared logins).
